title: Aligning Multi-Trajectory Supervision with Policy Optimization for VLA Driving
abstract: arXiv:2608.30122v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving methods increasingly combine multi-trajectory imitation learning with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), making trajectory selection critical to final performance. However, some high-scoring trajectories that improve imitation can degrade subsequent GRPO by inducing advantage estimates misaligned with the current policy's feasible behavior distribution, driving updates away from safe and compliant behaviors. To address this, we propose a novel framework that aligns multi-trajectory supervision with policy optimization. translated_title: 面向VLA驾驶的多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶方法日益将多轨迹模仿学习与组相对策略优化（GRPO）相结合，使得轨迹选择对最终性能至关重要。然而，某些能够提升模仿学习效果的高分轨迹，会因引发与当前策略可行行为分布不一致的优势估计而损害后续的GRPO，使策略更新偏离安全合规的行为。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种将多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐的新型框架。针对可行区域之外不可行噪声轨迹引起的策略梯度偏差，该方法将增强轨迹约束在真实可行区域的邻域流形内，并采用帕累托最优准则替代传统的聚合评分，仅保留非支配的候选轨迹，从而过滤掉冲突的样本。
tldr: 提出一种将多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐的框架，通过将增强轨迹约束在真实可行区域的邻域流形内并采用帕累托最优准则筛选非支配候选轨迹，避免了高分轨迹因优势估计与策略可行行为分布不一致而损害GRPO性能的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that aligns multi-trajectory supervision with policy optimization for VLA driving, constraining augmented trajectories to a neighboring manifold of the feasible region and adopting a Pareto-optimality criterion to retain non-dominated candidates, thereby preventing high-scoring trajectories from degrading GRPO through misaligned advantage estimates.
